name: rsk_getRawBlockHeaderByHash
summary: Returns the RLP-encoded header of the block with the given hash.
description: Returns the block header exactly as it is encoded for consensus, so it can be hashed or verified independently. Returns `null` when the node holds no block with that hash.

result.name: rawBlockHeader
result.description: The RLP-encoded block header, or `null` if the block is unknown

examples.name: getRawBlockHeaderByHashExample
examples.description: The result is abridged; a real encoded header is several hundred bytes long
